name: Fortior Technology (Shenzhen) Co., Ltd.
summary: Fortior Technology (Shenzhen) Co., Ltd. provides driver and control IC chips for various motor systems in Asian, North American, and European markets. The company's products include three-phase ASIC series, single-phase ASIC series, driver IC series, MOSFET series, MCU series, and IPM series. Its chips are used in various fields such as, automotive electronics, phone and kitchen appliances, health care, power tools, sports and travel, robots, IT and communications devices, and other driver control fields. The company was founded in 2010 and is headquartered in Shenzhen, China.
